pr.title: feat(cli): git stk run command on all branches in stack
pr.body: Closes #82 - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): list --all to list all stacks (#103)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/103)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): git stk run command on all branches in stack (#102)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/102)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[fix(cli): handle queued checks on github for merge --wait (#101)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/101)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: run treats a command that fails to spawn (e.g. not found) as a failed run, reporting a bogus FAIL on every branch instead of the spawn error.
